title: 🎨 Kids Mode is here!
body: The whole site now has a cartoon mode for kids: a colorful newsroom home with the correspondent cast, guides on every channel page who introduce themselves, and a quest board on the kid dashboard. Kids 10 and under get it by default, parents can lock a profile to Kids Mode or the straight site, and the switch lives in the top bar, the kid profile, and the family command deck.

title: 🚀 Stella guides Space Center
body: Space Center in Kids Mode is now Stella Reyes's Mission Control classroom: Stella welcomes you and walks you through search, fleets, tonight's flyovers, Orbit Lab, tours, time controls, and the model library, one control at a time — and the menus got a cartoony makeover with big rounded buttons. Replay it anytime with the Tour with Stella button.

title: 🎬 Meet the team — tap a portrait, watch their intro
body: The Meet the Correspondents page now uses the new Pixar portraits and team photos, and tapping any portrait plays that correspondent's 40-second intro video. Say hello to the whole crew before you read their stories.

title: 🛰️ Satellite orbits refresh every day
body: Space Center's 1,082 satellites now get fresh orbital data from CelesTrak every day, so positions stay true. The page shows the honest data date under the top bar, so you always know how fresh the orbits are.

title: ⭐ Starlink white, Others dark blue
body: Starlink satellites now shine white on the globe while the Others fleet shows dark blue, so the two fleets that used to look alike are easy to tell apart at a glance. The fleet legend matches the globe.

title: 📱 Videos play centered on phones
body: Intro and welcome videos now open centered in view on phones — in portrait and landscape, scrolled down the page or not — with the whole video and its Close button reachable. No more hunting for the player in empty space.

title: 🌌 Fly to the Moon and Mars
body: Mission Control's new Destinations tab flies you to the Moon and Mars at their real positions — meet lunar and Mars orbiters, tap 32 historic landing pins (Apollo, Perseverance, Chandrayaan-3…) with a full timeline, and watch city lights glow on Earth's night side.

title: 🛰️ Satellites become 3D models up close
body: Zoom into the ISS, Hubble, Chandra and four more to see real 3D spacecraft instead of dots — drag to orbit the camera around them while they hang in space.

title: 🌍 Sharper Earth, truer sunlight
body: A 4K NASA Blue Marble texture keeps coastlines crisp at max zoom, the day/night terminator now follows the real sun, and a faint globe seam was repaired.

title: 🧭 Smoother Mission Control flying
body: The spacetime grid stays fixed while the Earth spins beneath it, flying home smoothly resets the view, Moon/Mars visits no longer bounce on arrival, and clicking around up there won't yank you back to Earth.

title: ✨ Space Center joins signup & About
body: The signup page now teases Mission Control with an animated preview, and the About page explains the Space Center alongside 15 other things families get.

title: 🚀 Space Center becomes a real tool
body: See It Tonight predicts visible satellite flyovers over your house (with countdowns and add-to-calendar), the Orbit Lab lets kids build their own satellite, and the Orbit Zones guide explains how humanity divides up space — LEO, MEO, GEO and graveyard orbits.

title: 📸 Every satellite gets a photo + story
body: Tap any of the 1,082 tracked satellites, stations, rockets or launch pads for a real photo, who built it, launch year, live time-in-orbit and a fun fact. Plus 🎬 guided tours, 🎓 STEM missions, 🔬 great telescopes, 🟠 debris mode and ⚖️ satellite compare.

title: ✨ Space Center: What's New tab + 20 missions
body: A new What's New tab inside Mission Control lists every feature, and the mission board grew to 20 challenges so cadets discover them all.

title: Start Here: one page for everything
body: The How to Use page is now a full dashboard — every feature on Skynet Nexus explained on one page, with a transparency strip up top (who makes the news, free-forever funding, how safety works) and quick-start paths for parents, kids, and teachers. Find it via the new Start Here link at the top of the sidebar menu.

title: Meet the NEXUS SHIELD Security Team
body: Skynet Nexus now has a dedicated Security Team on patrol 24/7: Sentinel watches site health, Hunter tracks and blocks bad actors, and Guardian verifies our defenses every hour. Read how we protect your kids, family, and classroom on the new Safety & Security page (linked in every footer) — and admins can watch the team work live in the new Security command center.

title: 🧪 Beta HQ is live
body: Beta testers now have a Beta HQ page showing what's being built, what's fixed, and what's coming next. Find it in the footer when you're logged in as a beta tester.

title: 🏅 Beta Tester role
body: Beta testing is now a proper role you can pick at signup. Testers get early access to new features and a special badge.

title: 📊 Article sidebars are alive
body: Article pages now show the same live sidebar as the homepage: trending stories, stats, leaderboard, and polls.

title: 🏆 Live leaderboard
body: The Weekly Leaderboard now shows real reader rankings based on XP earned.

title: 🎧 Listen speed control
body: You can now adjust read-aloud speed (0.75x–1.5x) on any story. Great for younger readers.

title: ✅ Debug checklist for testers
body: Beta testers get a 105-item checklist to guide testing, with live progress tracking in their profile.

title: 🔍 Site search is here
body: Find any story in seconds — a brand-new search page with live-as-you-type results across every article we've published. Look for the search box in the nav.

title: 🔔 Push notifications are live
body: Never miss an edition drop. Turn on push alerts and we'll ping you the moment the Morning, Midday, or Evening edition lands — right through your browser.

title: 🎨 Kid Creations gallery rebuilt
body: The Creations gallery got a full makeover: browse what young readers are making, tap to like your favorites, and submit your own from the new Share form. Kid-safe as always — no names, just avatars.

title: ✉️ Contact form + leaderboard working
body: The contact page now actually sends your message to us, and the leaderboard shows real reader rankings instead of 'warming up.'

title: 🛡️ Email verification for parents
body: New parent accounts now verify by email before kid profiles can be added — an extra layer keeping kids' accounts in parents' hands. We've also rewritten our privacy notice in plain language and added a one-tap 'delete my kid's data' button for parents.

title: 🎧 Listen: more voices, on demand
body: The Listen feature now falls back to on-demand narration when a pre-made recording isn't ready yet, so every article can be heard in your chosen voice.

title: 💬 Private parent-teacher messaging
body: Teachers and parents can now message each other 1:1 about a specific child — conference requests, progress notes, quick questions. Each conversation gets its own private chat space. Find it under Teacher messages on the parent dashboard.

title: 📖 Read Together mode
body: The kitchen-table promise, made real: open any story in Read Together mode and read side by side. Parents see discussion prompts inline, kids get the Kid Take front and center, and tap-to-complete checkmarks track progress through story, summary, discussion, and vocabulary.

title: 🎨 Kid Creations Gallery
body: Kids can now share what they build! Submit experiments, art, and projects from the kid dashboard — parents approve, and approved creations go live in a public gallery where other families can ❤️ them.

title: 👴 Family feed & cheers
body: Grandparents and relatives finally have something to do: the Family feed shows achievements across your whole tree, and anyone in the family can send one-tap cheers. Kids see cheers on their dashboard.

title: 📧 Weekly parent email
body: A digest of your crew's week: XP earned, reading streaks, and one conversation starter for the dinner table. Preview anytime and toggle on/off in settings. Email delivery activates once Resend is connected.

title: 📢 Classroom announcements
body: Teachers can now broadcast to families — field trip Friday, quiz tomorrow, permission slips due. Pinned announcements stay on top. Parents see them in the new Class news tile.

title: 🔖 Reading lists & bookmarks
body: Tap the 🔖 button on any article to save it to a shelf — want to read or favorites. Kids manage shelves from their dashboard. Never lose a great story again.

title: 🚀 Kid dashboards are here
body: Every kid gets their own cinematic space: animated starfield, custom banner, editable quote, 100 avatars to pick from, interest picker, achievement wall, quiz galaxy with score history, family connections, classrooms, and STEM activities. Tap their card in the family dashboard to visit.

title: 🎨 100 kid avatars
body: 100 hand-crafted avatars in the Nexus Glow style — rockets, animals, robots, dragons, unicorns and more. Kids pick their favorite right from their dashboard.

title: 🌟 Teacher public profiles
body: Teachers get a professional public page: photo, bio, teaching quote, degrees, awards, school and subjects. Families can preview before joining a classroom.

title: 🌳 Family tree
body: Link your whole family — spouses, grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins. Create a family, share your invite code (only true family with the code can join), and everyone gets their own private family chat.

title: ✉️ Teacher invites
body: Teachers send email invites straight to parents. Parents create the account and link their child — teachers can never add students directly. Parents stay in control, always.

title: 🛡️ Child safety rules, front and center
body: Our protection rules now live on every parent and teacher dashboard: family-only by invite, parents own kid data, teachers see classroom stats only, no kid-to-kid contact, instant unlink anytime. Transparent by design.

title: ⚙️ Parent controls per kid
body: Fine-grained controls for each child: Listen on/off, pick exactly which of the 13 channels they see, discussions on/off, and public chat access (off by default — kids stay in family & classroom only unless you allow it). Plus full comment and question history with links to join the thread.

title: ♿ Accessibility for blind kids
body: Parents can declare blindness in their kid's profile — this unlocks the full suite: spoken audio guide for navigation, voice commands ('read this', 'next story', 'go home'), swipe gestures, double-tap to read aloud, large text and high contrast modes.

title: 💬 Safe chat system
body: Private chats for families and classrooms, plus solo notes and a moderated public square. Profanity filtered, parents and teachers can delete messages, anyone can report. Kids can't see public chat unless a parent allows it.

title: 🔒 Invite-gated signup
body: New accounts join via family or teacher invite codes. Signing up solo? You get a reading tracker with zero social features until a family or teacher invites you in. No open doors for strangers.

title: 🗳️ You pick the Weekend Lab
body: Every Thursday night, vote for which of the week's biggest STEM stories become Saturday's hands-on activities. The top picks win — the Lab is built around what families chose.

title: 📸 Photos, videos & sources on every article
body: Stories now carry media galleries with credited photos and videos, a source list with trust labels (official source, research paper, news report), 'try it yourself' links that turn news into hands-on fun, and watch embeds for the story's video.

title: 🧪 Weekend Lab: Saturday STEM
body: Five fresh family STEM activities every Saturday morning, made from household materials — a fun way to catch up on the week's stories by doing, not just reading.

title: ✨ A simpler Skynet Nexus
body: New collapsible sidebar organized around what you do here — Do, Read, Community, You — and a shorter name to match the bigger mission: the Nexus of STEM for families.

Teachers can now create classrooms, add their students, track everyone's reading progress (XP, levels, streaks, badges) on a live dashboard, and start threaded article discussions the whole class can join.
title: 🏫 Classroom system for teachers

body: Kids earn XP for every step of the reading journey — finishing the story (10), the Kid Take (5), talking it over together (15), and learning new words (5). Climb 7 ranks from Rookie Reader to Editor-in-Chief, earn 20 badges, and build daily reading streaks. Parents and teachers earn XP too: +10 for co-reading, +20 for hosting a class discussion.
title: 🏆 Junior Correspondent gamification

body: You can now sign up as a Teacher (not just a Parent). Teachers create student profiles the same way parents create kid profiles, and can be promoted to Editor or Admin from the Users panel.
title: Teacher accounts are here

body: Tap any correspondent's name or portrait on a story to jump to their bio on the Meet the Correspondents page — and every bio links to all of that correspondent's stories. You can also pick your portrait style (Humans, Animals, or Skynet Agents) for your whole account from your profile page.
title: Correspondent bylines link to bios

body: All 13 channel correspondents now have full bios, fun facts, and portraits in three styles: Humans, Animals, and Skynet Agents. Each kid picks their favorite style in their profile, and the whole site re-skins to match.
title: Meet the Correspondents — 3 art styles

body: Articles now walk you through the full family reading flow: the story, the Kid Take (age-8 reading level), Talk Together discussion questions, and Words to Know — with a scroll-spy so you always know where you are. Plus: download any article's artwork free for wallpapers and school projects.
title: Guided co-reading journey

body: Fresh stories drop three times a day — 7:15 AM, 2:15 PM, and 6:15 PM Eastern — each with its own front page. Thirteen correspondents file one story per edition across every channel.
title: Three daily editions

body: Every edition's top stories are now drafted as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels scripts — hook, script, caption, hashtags — waiting for review in the admin Social tab. (Posting is still manual for now.)
title: Social drafts queue (admin)
